description: A gray plastic tub with clear ice cubes sits on the bed in front of a yellow cup, with a purple scoop lying to the right. The left hand reaches to the yellow cup, grips it as a left-hand object, lifts it up and to the right over the tub, then tips it downward to dump the ice cubes into the tub before rotating it upright and setting it back down to the left, while the right hand stays near the purple scoop without touching it.
